recentItems.title: Breaking Bad's Bryan Cranston MOURNS onscreen son RJ Mitte's d*ath, RECALLS their last texts!
recentItems.description:
Bryan Cranston is mourning the reported death of his Breaking Bad co-star RJ Mitte at the age of 34. In an emotional tribute, Cranston remembered his on-screen son and revealed that they had exchanged text messages just weeks before his death while trying to plan a lunch together. He also expressed his love for Mitte, recalling their special bond during and after the hit series. Watch the video for Bryan Cranston’s heartfelt tribute to RJ Mitte.
